prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a maple avenue in full autumn colour with a pale path scattered with red and gold leaves, a standard park bench and lamp posts, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Italian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, a smouldering, confident expression, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in sleek straight, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large brass hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a gold round bell, a copper chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three platinum anklets. Extra long nails in matching polished purpleheart wood.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: full body deep violet purpleheart wood carved directly over her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, this is solid carved wood curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep violet purpleheart grain across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID lilac highlight streaks running between the carved sections, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Her face stays real living skin and the carving ends cleanly at the neck.
LEFT Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme thigh-high platform stiletto boots carved from the same purpleheart wood, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult German person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a handsome male model face with high cheekbones, a straight nose, a firm jaw and straight dark brows, a very faint trace of stubble, deep plum smoky eyes with dark lashes, fair skin with a neutral undertone, a relaxed half-smile, cool ash-grey hair styled in wavy, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a gold ship's anchor, a silver round bell, a gold small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a gold hammer head, a lead square-sided cowbell, a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a bronze small flared temple bell, an iron teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three silver rings. Extremely long square nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: Her body carries overlapping mother-of-pearl nacre tiles set edge to edge over her skin, each tile with a fine edge and a soft milky lustre that shifts through rainbow colours across every curve, BLAZING milky pearl-white nacre with pink and aqua lustre, VIVID soft rainbow sheen sliding across each tile. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform high-heel mules, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
